item.title: Rust Smart Pointers
item.description: A linked list written as a plain enum fails with E0072, and an Rc sent to a thread fails with E0277. Box lifts the rule that sizes must be known at compile time, while Rc, RefCell, Arc, and Mutex each relax the one-owner, no-overlapping-borrows rule, paying with a heap allocation, count updates, run-time checks, or locking. The seventh post in a Rust study series.
